c74object.name: ear.hoa
c74object.digest: Calculate the decoding matrix of an ambisonic scene (ADM HOA) for a BS.2051 loudspeaker layout with libear (ITU-R BS.2127): the gains mc.ear.hoa~ applies, as lists
c74object.description: Calculate the decoding matrix of an ambisonic scene (ADM HOA) for a BS.2051 loudspeaker layout with libear (ITU-R BS.2127): the gains mc.ear.hoa~ applies, as lists. The scene's components are in ACN order (W Y Z X ... for first order), SN3D by default; the decoder is the EAR's AllRAD design for the layout. Outputs one list per component (its channel number followed by a gain per loudspeaker, ready for coll) and the whole matrix as matrix~ messages (input output gain).

method.name: autocalc
method.description: Set the autocalc attribute. Output the matrix whenever the layout, order or normalization changes. When off, send a bang to output it. Nothing is output when the object is created: send a bang (from loadbang) for the initial matrix.

method.name: channels
method.digest: Output the channel names of the layout from the right outlet
method.description: Output the channel names of the layout from the right outlet.

method.name: components
method.digest: Output the order and degree of each component from the right outlet: 'components' followed by an order and degree pair per ACN channel
method.description: Output the order and degree of each component from the right outlet: 'components' followed by an order and degree pair per ACN channel.

method.name: layout
method.description: Set the layout attribute. ITU-R BS.2051 loudspeaker layout name, such as 0+2+0, 0+5+0, 2+5+0, 4+5+0, 4+9+0, 9+10+3. Send 'layouts' to list all names.

method.name: layouts
method.digest: Output the names of all known layouts from the right outlet
method.description: Output the names of all known layouts from the right outlet.

method.name: normalization
method.description: Set the normalization attribute. Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa.

method.name: order
method.description: Set the order attribute. Ambisonic order of the scene, 0 to 8: the scene has (order+1)^2 components in ACN order.

method.name: positions
method.digest: Output the nominal loudspeaker positions from the right outlet
method.description: Output the nominal loudspeaker positions from the right outlet.

attribute.name: autocalc

attribute.name: normalization
attribute.digest: Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa
attribute.description: Normalization of the ambisonic components: SN3D (the ADM default, also AmbiX), N3D or FuMa. Default: SN3D.

attribute.description: Ambisonic order of the scene, 0 to 8: the scene has (order+1)^2 components in ACN order. Default: 1.
